reason: Opened agent QA-20261123-093400-qrz5, confirmed it was idle, sent "Hello! What is 2+2?", and verified the reply contains 4.
steps: Step 1: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — the Gamut home page loaded with both agents listed in the sidebar and the "Your Agents" cards.
Step 2: Clicked QA-20261123-093400-qrz5 in the sidebar — the agent page opened at /agents/qa-20261123-093400-qrz5-ib4miqix29 with the agent name in the header.
Step 3: Checked agent status — the header status reads "idle", which is an accepted status (no bug).

Step 4: Typed "Hello! What is 2+2?" into the message box — the text appeared correctly. I then made a mistake: I clicked "Add files" instead of Send, which opened a Files/Folder chooser. Escape did not close it right away. I then clicked the enabled Send button, and the message was sent. The chooser was gone by the time the reply rendered. This was my misclick, not an app defect, though the chooser staying open after Escape is worth a look.
Step 5: Waited for the response — the reply appeared immediately after sending (no wait needed), and the session "Basic Arithmetic Question Check" was created in the sidebar.
Step 6: Verified the response — the assistant replied "2 + 2 = 4.", which mentions 4. Screenshot taken showing the user message and the reply.
